introduction_en: LIAPLIAS supplies a complete range of ejector pins for injection molds, including standard ejector pins, thin ejector pins, blade ejectors and ejector sleeves. Compatible with HASCO Z40 and Meusburger E3000 series, with nitrided surface treatment for extended service life.

Kompatibel mit den HASCO Z40- und Meusburger E3000-Serien, mit nitrierter Oberfläche für eine verlängerte Lebensdauer.
introduction_zh: LIAPLIAS 供应完整的注塑模具顶针系列，包括标准顶针、细径顶针、扁顶针和司筒。兼容 HASCO Z40 和 Meusburger E3000 系列，氮化表面处理延长使用寿命。

meta_description_en: Browse LIAPLIAS's mold fastening components range — socket head screws, set screws and stainless fasteners for mold assembly. DIN 912/913 compliant. Request a quote today.

introduction_en: LIAPLIAS provides mold standard fastening components including socket head cap screws, set screws and stainless steel fasteners. Compatible with HASCO Z30/Z36 and Meusburger E1900/E1950 series, available in class 12.9 alloy steel and A2-70 stainless steel.
introduction_zh: LIAPLIAS 提供模具标准紧固件，包括内六角螺栓、紧定螺钉和不锈钢紧固件。兼容 HASCO Z30/Z36 和 Meusburger E1900/E1950 系列，提供 12.9 级合金钢和 A2-70 不锈钢材质。

meta_description_en: Browse LIAPLIAS's mold die springs and compression springs range — light, medium, heavy and extra heavy loads. ISO 10243 compliant. Request a quote today.

introduction_en: LIAPLIAS supplies mold die springs and nitrogen springs for injection molds and stamping dies. Available in multiple load ratings including light (yellow), medium (blue), heavy (red) and extra heavy (green). Compatible with HASCO Z165/Z166 and Meusburger F4200 series.

introduction_en: LIAPLIAS provides locating and centering components for precise mold alignment. Includes locating pins, locating bushings and locating rings. Compatible with HASCO Z71/Z73/Z53 and Meusburger E2300/E2310/E2110 series, with hardened precision-ground surfaces.
introduction_zh: LIAPLIAS 提供定位和定心组件，用于精密模具对中。包括定位销、定位套和定位环。兼容 HASCO Z71/Z73/Z53 和 Meusburger E2300/E2310/E2110 系列，淬硬精密磨削表面。

introduction_en: LIAPLIAS supplies a comprehensive range of mold standard components including sprue bushings, return pins, ball guide pillars, graphite bushings and temperature regulation fittings. Compatible with HASCO and Meusburger standard systems, supporting injection molding, die casting and high-temperature tooling applications.
